lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: I heard that you'd be filling in as a substitute teacher?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: The joint assessment is going to be held twice,

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: with the final score being the average of the two scores put together.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: I wasn't sure if you'd been informed of this,

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: but I figured I'd send you a bla just to make sure you're aware.
Thanks for letting me know.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: No problem. I'll see you soon.
See you.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Lovely Sweets magazine issue #7 pre-ordered.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Only Animals magazine issue #3 ordered.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Cutie Dolls limited-edition issue ordered.
There is no reply from Marciana for a while.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Sorry, those were sent to you by accident.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: It would appear my Bla account is linked to my tablet.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Don't get any wrong ideas.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: I'm a teacher, and these purchases are purely for research purposes.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: To help me analyze the interests of my students.
What are they?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: One is a magazine on desserts, another on animals, and the other on dolls.
I like all of those things.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: ... What?
They're all super cute.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: So you like cute things?
Most definitely.
Again, there is no reply from Marciana for a while.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Lately...

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Cute desserts have been all the rage amongst the students.
Come to think of it, a new dessert just came out at the Maid Cafe.
Desserts are my weakness. I'm powerless to resist them.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Maid Cafe?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: The one where Cocoa works?
Yep, that's the place.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: What do you know about cute desserts in particular?
I know a bit.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Like, say, the new strawberry cat crepe?
I'm drooling just hearing you say the name.
Sounds to me like we should have a dessert date.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: But...
If you want to understand what the students are into, wouldn't it be best for you to have first-hand experience?
Again, there is no reply from Marciana for a while.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: You have a point.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: All right,

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: we can meet up to have some dessert.
It's a date.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: ... Sounds good.
